sql: select market_ticker, side, limit_price, quantity, status, cancel_reason, created_at, raw_order_json->>'fill_count' as fc, raw_order_json->>'status' as ks from live_orders where strategy='Alimm1' and market_ticker like 'KXTRUMPMENTION%' and created_at > '2026-10-07 00:00' order by created_at desc limit 5
